text:
Evan L.: Heads-up - NimbusHealth asked for a dedicated POC pool in eu-west-1. Prefer H100 but want an A100 fallback. Need quick guidance on SKU, count, CIDR, and whether we can waive commit for a 30-day trial.
Priya M.: What are the perf targets and spike profile?
Evan L.: Target ~180 qps, p95 <=250ms for 512-token contexts, demo spikes to ~600 qps for ~10mins. Team: 3 devs + 2 infra. Require EU-only data and org-managed KMS.
Diego R.: Suggest 4xH100 baseline + burst for spikes, or 8xA100 if they prefer capacity over latency. We need a /28 CIDR for peering; private control plane adds another /28.
Priya M.: Can you paste a CLI snippet for their network team to approve CIDR? Also need rough cost delta for quote.
Diego R.: CLI snippet:
```
rictl pool create --name nimbus-poc --region eu-west-1 \
  --sku h100 --count 4 --burst-enabled true \
  --vpc-peer-cidr 10.8.64.0/28 --kms-key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:555566667777:key/klmn1234 \
  --contact security:nimbus@health.com
```
Evan L.: Ops - can we waive the monthly commit for 30 days? Timeline to provision after PO + CIDR?
OpsBot: Request logged. Ticket #POC-9610 created. Ops review in 1 business day. Typical provision time 48-72 hours after approvals; burst may add 24h.
Nimbus Infra (external): We can provide 10.8.64.0/28 and dev IP list. PO in legal, will update tomorrow.
Priya M.: I'll prepare SOC2/KMS answers and ask Finance for a token-level estimate for both 4xH100 and 8xA100. Add canary + auto-fallback to quantized model in rollout.
Diego R.: Noted - will include canary route and model pinning. Also enable token-level usage logs for billing audit.
Evan L.: Thanks - I'll follow up when PO and CIDR arrive. :thumbsup:
